short: a picture in passes: switch models, lock and enlarge

about.zh: 一张图分几步画时有哪几种路子：同一张图前后段换模型、锁住原图再放大重画（可以顺手换成同类的第二个模型）、画完换模型接着修；什么时候必须是同一类模型，你选的画风 LoRA 要不要一起挂到第二个模型上。只说怎么做，具体数值在做法里；你存过的路线卡和搭配优先原样用，你没选的画风和 LoRA 不加。
about.en: The ways to make one picture in passes: different models for its early and late steps, a locked redraw while enlarging (which may switch to a second model of the same family), and model after model; when the models must be of one family, and whether your style LoRA goes onto the second model too. How, not values: those live in the ways. A route card or combo you saved comes first, as it is; no style or LoRA you did not pick.

text: Use when the user wants a picture made in passes, or one model for the composition and another for the look (style, skin, texture); not a default for every picture.

A route the user saved is the daily run: a workflow card (list_workflows; "name / preset" when it has presets) or a combo (list_combos), with their subject and seed; its models, LoRAs and values are theirs, unchanged. Another route is another card. Never add a style, artist or LoRA the user did not pick.
Show the first pass before the second, so the user can pick the base; keep it to compare.

Ways to stage, by what the user wants. Switch models within one picture: the early steps settle the composition on one model, the later steps finish it on another (add_nodes use="refine", want="midway"). Enlarge with a lock: a guide holding the picture (Tile) lets the redraw go much stronger, adding detail while the composition holds; without one a strong redraw moves the pose and ornaments. The locked redraw may keep the model (use="upscale", want="detail"; on Anima want="anima tile") or switch in that same redraw to a second model of the same family for a steadier enlargement or better skin and texture (want="steady"): one redraw, no extra refine pass after it. Model after model: one finishes, the next lightly redraws the whole picture (use="refine"); a chain of several is fine.

Families: a switch that reuses the first stage's prompts and VAE needs a second model of the same family (sharing the text encoder and VAE): the mid-way switch, the second-model upscale, and the refine on a model split into UNET, text encoder and VAE files (Anima). The refine with a checkpoint of its own (its own CLIP and VAE, on the decoded picture) may cross families: rewrite its positive and negative prompts in the new family's way. A combination not tried here: say it is untried.

The second model is loaded bare. When the first stage has a style LoRA the user picked and they want that look kept, borrowing only the second model's skin or detail, add_lora it onto the second model too; leave it off only when they want the look changed. Never add one they did not pick.

These ways come from a few single-seed comparisons. A strong redraw changes faces, hands and small ornaments even with a lock: say what ran and what changed; promise no exact reproduction and no repaired hands.
